description: NC start was blocked after program transfer. Operator could not resume automatic cycle.
resolution: Verified selected part program, reset channel state, confirmed feed hold was released, then restarted NC cycle successfully.
notes: If alarm 3000 repeats on CNC-LINE-01, check recent program transfer records before replacing hardware.

description: Intermittent channel alarm appeared during warm-up. No tool collision observed.
resolution: Checked axis enable state, cleared stale channel request, performed dry-run verification, and returned machine to production.
notes: Keep this as a reference case for channel-state alarms after idle periods.

description: Repeated NC start alarm after fixture change. Pending check of operator panel mode and program lock.
notes: Open case for dashboard and work-order board demonstration.

description: Emergency stop chain active during training station startup.
notes: Safety lead must verify reset procedure before demo restart.

description: Axis enable alarm appeared after power cycle.
resolution: Confirmed drive ready signal, checked axis enable relay, reset reference state, and completed a low-speed jog test.
notes: Use this case when axis alarms follow a full power cycle.

description: Spindle did not reach ready state before cycle start.
resolution: Inspected spindle enable chain, cleaned connector, verified encoder feedback, and ran spindle warm-up.
notes: Connector cleaning resolved the recurring symptom on CNC-LINE-05.

description: Cycle alarm after operator edited a subprogram.
resolution: Restored approved subprogram, performed syntax check, and restarted dry run.
notes: Compare active program hash before deeper electrical checks.

description: PLC diagnostic bit stayed active after pallet change.
notes: Controls team is checking interlock timing.

description: Drive alarm appeared during acceleration test.
notes: Reserve for demo of assigned high-priority work.

description: Safety door interlock was open during training startup.
resolution: Verified door switch alignment, reset safety relay, and documented the operator acknowledgement.
notes: Training station cases should keep the safety verification notes visible.
